description: This file defines marker shapes and icon containers for map widgets, including enums, mappings, SVG manipulation functions, and icon creation utilities for a mapping component in an Angular project.

methods.name: generateElementId
methods.description: Generates a unique element ID, prefixing with 'a' if the ID starts with a digit.

methods.name: prepareSvgIds
methods.description: Replaces IDs within an SVG element with unique IDs to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: createColorMarkerShape
methods.description: Loads an SVG icon from URL, applies color and opacity styles, and prepares it for use.

methods.name: createColorMarkerShapeURI
methods.description: Creates a base64-encoded data URI of a colored SVG marker shape.

methods.name: createIconElement
methods.description: Creates an SVG element for an icon, either SVG or text, with specified size and color.

methods.name: createColorMarkerIconElement
methods.description: Combines a marker shape and icon into an SVG element with specified color.

methods.name: createPlaceItemIcon
methods.description: Returns an observable URI for a default place item icon, caching the result.

methods.name: calculateIconCenter
methods.description: Calculates the center coordinates of an SVG icon element for proper positioning.
